purpose: Headless real E2E baseline for Local ASR Bridge providers. This fixture set is curated to favor short, endpoint-friendly stable utterances so external ws bridges can reliably produce final transcripts and graph output.

selectionReason: Current sherpa reference bridge can consistently emit endpoint finals for these clips.
The clips cover short utterances, mixed zh-en content, and multiple final boundaries.
They are better suited for Local ASR Bridge regression than the previous English-only synthetic fixture.

baselineNotes: This fixture is a local-bridge-friendly baseline, not a semantic gold transcript corpus.
Real acceptance is intentionally anchored on keyword groups and graph production, not exact verbatim text.
If you replace the audio, you must rerun the real local-bridge E2E and refresh keyword anchors.
